obtain_metadata: load adsorbed bulk metadata from a pickle file given an input directory and data split tag
create_df: create a pandas DataFrame from a list of adslab metadata tuples and save it to CSV
adslabs_are_unique: test if a DataFrame of adslab metadata contains any duplicate entries based on fingerprint columns
check_commonelems: check for common adsorbate or bulk materials between two dataset splits in a DataFrame
is_adsorbate_placed_correct: verify all adsorbate atoms are connected after placement on an ASE Atoms adslab structure
